_comment: Ashfall display overlay. Merged by id over game_data.json (GameData.applyOverlay); ids and balance stay as they are. Design: docs/ASHFALL_DESIGN.md section 3, 3.2, 10, 13.

WHIP.name: Vibro Lash
WHIP.description: Horizontal vibro-blade slash that cuts through every enemy in line.

VAMPIRICA.name: Leech Scythe
VAMPIRICA.description: Evolved Vibro Lash. Can crit and drains the wounded to heal you.

MAGIC_MISSILE.name: Spore Dart
MAGIC_MISSILE.description: Launches a spore dart at the nearest enemy.

HOLY_MISSILE.name: Lumen Volley
HOLY_MISSILE.description: Evolved Spore Dart. Fires with no delay.

KNIFE.name: Scalpel Throw
KNIFE.description: Throws scalpels fast in the direction you face.

THOUSAND.name: Scalpel Storm
THOUSAND.description: Evolved Scalpel Throw. Fires with no delay.

AXE.name: Cluster Grenade
AXE.description: Lobs a grenade in an arc. High damage, scales strongly with area.

SCYTHE.name: Shrapnel Spiral
SCYTHE.description: Evolved Cluster Grenade. Spinning shrapnel passes through enemies.

CROSS.name: Ricochet Drone
CROSS.description: A drone that hunts the nearest enemy and boomerangs back.

HEAVENSWORD.name: Strike Wing
HEAVENSWORD.description: Evolved Ricochet Drone. Can deal critical damage.

HOLYBOOK.name: Ward Drones
HOLYBOOK.description: Drones orbit you, shielding and striking whatever they touch.

VESPERS.name: Sentinel Ring
VESPERS.description: Evolved Ward Drones. The ring never ends.

FIREBALL.name: Slag Cannon
FIREBALL.description: Fires molten slag at a random enemy for heavy damage.

HELLFIRE.name: Furnace Burst
HELLFIRE.description: Evolved Slag Cannon. Passes through enemies.

GARLIC.name: Toxic Vent
GARLIC.description: Vents a toxic cloud that damages nearby enemies and weakens their knockback resistance.

VORTEX.name: Lumen Devourer
VORTEX.description: Evolved Toxic Vent. Feeds on the dying; power grows when you recover HP.

HOLYWATER.name: Corrosive Flask
HOLYWATER.description: Throws flasks that leave damaging pools.

BORA.name: Corrosive Wake
BORA.description: Evolved Corrosive Flask. The pools follow you and grow as they move.

LIGHTNING.name: Arc Coil
LIGHTNING.description: Arcs of lightning strike random enemies.

LOOP.name: Tesla Loop
LOOP.description: Evolved Arc Coil. Every strike hits twice.

ARMOR.name: Plate Weave
ARMOR.description: Reduces incoming damage by 1. Increases retaliatory damage by 10%.

AREA.name: Wide-Beam Lens
AREA.description: Augments the area of attacks by 10%.

DURATION.name: Stabilizer Coil
DURATION.description: Increases the duration of weapon effects by 10%.

MAGNET.name: Gravity Collar
MAGNET.description: You pick up items from further away.

CURSE.name: Spore Taint
CURSE.description: Increases enemy speed, health and quantity.
